script: if(window.__sniffBridgeInited!==true){function sniffResource(){var list=document.querySelectorAll('ul.hl-one-list div.hl-item-div');if(!list||0==list.length){sendResourceList([]);return}const resourceList=[];for(const item of list){var aWrapper=item.querySelector('a.hl-item-thumb');if(!aWrapper)continue;var url=aWrapper.href;var img=aWrapper.getAttribute('data-original');var title=aWrapper.getAttribute('title').trim();var descEl=item.querySelector('.hl-item-content > p.hl-item-sub.hl-text-muted.hl-lc-2');var blurb='';if(descEl){blurb=descEl.textContent}resourceList.push({id:getId(url),name:title,url:url,img:img,blurb:blurb})}sendResourceList(resourceList)}function sniffEpisode(){var root=document.querySelector('.hl-play-source');var menuList=root.querySelectorAll('.hl-plays-wrap .hl-plays-from a.hl-tabs-btn');var sourceList=root.querySelectorAll('div.hl-tabs-box ul.hl-plays-list');if(!sourceList||0==sourceList.length){sendEpisodeList([]);return}var sourceMap={};for(var i=0;i<sourceList.length;i++){var episodeList=sourceList[i].querySelectorAll('a:not(.hl-show-list)');if(0==episodeList.length)continue;var sourceName=menuList[i].getAttribute('alt');if(sourceName==='X.3'){continue}sourceMap[sourceName]=Array.from(episodeList).map(item=>({name:item.textContent,url:item.href}))}sendSourceMap(sourceMap)}async function sniffPlayUrl(){const iframe=document.querySelector('#playleft iframe');if(iframe){let src=iframe.getAttribute('src');if(src&&!src.startsWith('http')){src=window.location.origin+src}sendLoadIframe(src);return}const video=await waitForElement('video',10,200);if(!video){sniffLog('未找到video元素');sendPlayUrl('');return}const playUrl=video.getAttribute('src');if(!playUrl||!playUrl.startsWith('blob:')){sendPlayUrl(playUrl);return}sendPlayUrl('')}function waitForElement(selector,maxRetry=10,intervalMs=200){return new Promise((resolve)=>{let count=0;function poll(){const el=document.querySelector(selector);if(el){resolve(el);return}count++;if(count>=maxRetry){resolve(null);return}setTimeout(poll,intervalMs)}poll()})}function getId(uri){const url=new URL(uri);const path=url.pathname;const filename=path.split('/').pop();return filename}window.taskSniffResource=function(){sniffLog('开始执行任务：获取资源信息');sniffResource();sniffLog('任务执行完成：获取资源信息')};window.taskSniffEpisode=function(){sniffLog('开始执行任务：获取分集列表');sniffEpisode();sniffLog('任务执行完成：获取分集列表')};window.taskSniffPlayUrl=function(){sniffLog('开始执行任务：嗅探播放地址');sniffPlayUrl();sniffLog('任务执行完成：嗅探播放地址')};function sendToFlutter(msg){window.FlutterBridge&&window.FlutterBridge.postMessage(JSON.stringify(msg))}function sniffLog(text){sendToFlutter({msgType:'log',payload:String(text)})}function sendResourceList(list){sendToFlutter({msgType:'resourceList',payload:list})}function sendSourceMap(map){sendToFlutter({msgType:'sourceMap',payload:map})}function sendPlayUrl(url){sendToFlutter({msgType:'playUrl',payload:String(url)})}function sendLoadIframe(url){sendToFlutter({msgType:'loadIframe',payload:String(url)})}}else{'undefined'!==typeof sniffLog&&sniffLog('桥接脚本已存在，跳过重复注入')}
